rationale: Endermen drop the pearls, but a calm one wanders and teleports, so chasing it rarely lands a hit, and a mob below or behind blocks is out of reach. A vanilla player picks one, looks at its eyes for a moment from a spot they can fight from, then fights it in place as it teleports in, ideally where only one can reach (a 2-high opening a 3-tall enderman cannot enter). Each hit costs about 4 health through iron armour, so at low health in contact a player breaks contact before eating.
